title: The 8 Best Router for Woodworking 2026
metaDescription: Our 8 picks for router for woodworking 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at router for woodworking 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Bosch 1617EVSPK 2.25 HP Variable-Speed Router Combo Kit
products.blurb: Key specs: 2.25 HP motor, Fixed and plunge base kit, Variable speed 8,000-25,000 RPM.
strengths: Includes both fixed and plunge bases -- covers handheld and router table configurations in one purchase
Variable speed allows running large-diameter bits at lower RPM to prevent burning
Bosch 1617 is the most commonly recommended router kit for new woodworkers by experienced woodworkers
Soft-start motor reduces startup jerk that throws the router off-line
limitations: 2.25 HP is adequate but not the most powerful for large-diameter bits in dense hardwood
Plunge lock can be stiff on new units
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: Festool 574692 OF 1400 EQ Router
products.blurb: Key specs: 2.0 HP, Constant electronics, Systainer compatible.
strengths: Constant electronics maintain speed under load -- the bit does not slow down as it enters hardwood
German manufacturing precision -- every Festool router is calibrated before shipping
Systainer storage integrates with the full Festool dust collection and storage system
The tool of choice in professional furniture and cabinet shops worldwide
limitations: Festool system lock-in -- accessories are proprietary
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: DEWALT DWP611PK Compact Router Combo Kit
products.blurb: Key specs: 1.25 HP compact motor, Fixed and plunge bases, LED work light.
strengths: Compact size fits into router table inserts and router table positions for light table work
Fixed and plunge bases included for both handheld and plunge applications
LED work lights illuminate the cut area for precise bit positioning
The most popular compact trim router -- widely recommended for edge profiling and small-diameter bits
limitations: 1.25 HP -- underpowered for large-diameter bits (1-inch roundover, panel raisers) in hardwood

products.name: PORTER-CABLE 690LR 11-Amp Fixed Base Router
products.blurb: Key specs: 1.75 HP, Fixed base, Standard mounting pattern.
strengths: Fixed base design is the correct configuration for router table use -- no plunge mechanism to catch
Standard mounting hole pattern fits most aftermarket router table inserts (Rockler, Kreg)
1.75 HP is adequate for most router table profiles including raised panels
The most commonly recommended dedicated router table motor
limitations: Fixed base only -- no plunge capability for handheld mortising
Less common in retail stores than Bosch or DeWalt

products.name: Makita RT0701CX7 1-1/4 HP Compact Router Kit
products.blurb: Key specs: 1.25 HP, Multiple bases, Variable speed.
strengths: Makita precision and build quality in a compact router form
Kit includes multiple base configurations including plunge, fixed, and tilt bases
Variable speed from 10,000 to 30,000 RPM -- covers the widest speed range of any trim router
The Makita alternative for woodworkers already in the Makita ecosystem
limitations: Highest speed at 30,000 RPM can burn some wood species at the top speed setting

products.name: Triton TRA001 3-1/4 HP Dual Mode Precision Plunge Router
products.blurb: Key specs: 3.25 HP, Router table lift compatible, Above-table bit change.
strengths: 3.25 HP is the highest power in the plunge router category -- no bit slowdown in dense hardwood
Above-table bit change capability -- change bits without removing the router from the table
Compatible with router table lift systems for precise height adjustment
The correct router for heavy router table use with large-diameter panel raisers and cope-and-stick sets
limitations: Heavy -- 11 lbs -- difficult for extended handheld use
High power requires high-quality bits -- budget bits may not withstand 3.25 HP input

products.name: Bosch GKF125CEN Colt 1.25 HP Variable-Speed Palm Router
products.blurb: Key specs: 1.25 HP palm router, Fixed base, Variable speed.
strengths: The most compact, lightweight router Bosch produces -- palm router form factor
Variable speed for small-diameter bits in different materials
The correct second router for woodworkers who own a full-size Bosch 1617 and need a compact router
Easy single-hand control for edge profiling and light work
limitations: 1.25 HP limits use to small-diameter bits

products.name: DEWALT 20V Max XR Cordless Router, Brushless (DCW600B)
products.blurb: Key specs: 20V MAX XR cordless, Brushless motor, Variable speed 16,000-25,000 RPM.
strengths: Cordless operation eliminates cord management during handheld routing -- significant convenience
Brushless motor provides corded-level power from a 20V MAX battery
Variable speed control and dual LED lights illuminate the cut area
The correct router for on-site work, outdoor projects, and any situation where a power cord is inconvenient
limitations: Battery life limits sustained use -- have a second battery for long routing sessions
Tool only -- battery and charger not included

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
